title: arducam_tof driver node on the Arducam SDK with pydantic config and mocked-SDK tests
requirement: Tests first (tests/test_config.py, tests/test_bridge.py with ArducamDepthCamera mocked), seen failing before the code. (1) config.py: pydantic model loaded from the YAML at ARDUCAM_TOF_CONFIG with camera_index (default 0), range_mode (near or far, default far), confidence_threshold, frame_id, publish_rate_hz, metrics_port; unknown keys and out-of-range values are rejected. (2) bridge.py publishes /tof/depth/image_raw (sensor_msgs/Image 16UC1, millimetres, pixels with confidence below the threshold set to 0 = invalid), /tof/amplitude/image_raw (mono16, amplitude or confidence from the SDK) and /tof/camera_info, all stamped with one header and frame_id, at no more than publish_rate_hz. (3) A failed or missing frame publishes nothing for that cycle, logs it with the ROS2 logger and increments a metrics counter; no zero, default or synthetic frame is ever published; a camera that fails to open logs and retries without publishing. (4) Flat layout like nodes/bridges/uvc_camera (package dir arducam_tof, python3 -m arducam_tof), type hints, constants on top, docstrings with types, ros2-metrics path dependency, numpy in the pyproject dependencies (numpy dependency guard), ArducamDepthCamera declared as an aarch64/linux-only dependency so macOS uv sync and tests still work with the mock. (5) uv.lock committed; ruff and vulture clean.
value: A real ToF depth and amplitude source the web UI can show as soon as the camera is plugged in.
notes: Mirror nodes/bridges/uvc_camera (layout, ros_stubs-style rclpy stubs in tests, metrics wiring) and nodes/leader_bridge (pydantic config). Amplitude encoding (mono8 vs mono16) and default range mode are the builder's call; document the choice in a module docstring for the README task. Frames expose depth_data and confidence_data. camera_index may need 1 on cam1.
verify: cd nodes/bridges/arducam_tof && uv run pytest tests -q && uv run poe lint

requirement: Tests first in tests/test_arducam_tof_config.py, seen failing. value: The driver deploys to the client switched off, so enabling it later is a one-line change.
notes: Mirror 60d7421 (leader_bridge) and the gripper_uvc_camera entry at client.yml:900. Hardware-dependent facts (noble install, cam1 index) stay unproven until the camera is plugged in, hence disabled and non-fatal. The wheel installs through the node's uv deps (T1). title: web_ui backend: head tab type, topic fields, hints and greyscale depth serializer
requirement: Tests first in nodes/web_ui/tests/test_config.py, test_bridge.py and test_msg_serializer.py, seen failing. (1) `head` is in VALID_TAB_TYPES; TabConfig has rgb_camera_topic, tof_depth_topic, tof_amplitude_topic (str or None) and tof_range_m (positive float, default 4.0, rejected when not positive), and the three topic fields are in GENERIC_TOPIC_ATTRS so all_subscribed_topics() contains them; (2) TOPIC_TYPE_HINTS subscribe the compressed RGB topic as CompressedImage and the ToF depth and amplitude topics as Image (a hint or role entry that works for arbitrary configured topic names); (3) the 16UC1 depth serializer renders a greyscale preview (near bright, far dark, 0 = invalid black) over [0, tof_range_m] and still returns depth_preview_b64, depth_b64, depth_width, depth_height; the range reaches the serializer from the tab config without changing the existing rgbd tab output, which keeps its current output; (4) mono16 and mono8 amplitude Images serialise to a greyscale JPEG preview (same jpeg_b64 field the camera streams use); (5) a 32FC1 or unknown encoding is not decoded as colour (it raises or is skipped and logged), and previews are rate-limited like the other camera previews; (6) uv run poe lint clean.
value: The browser receives real ToF depth and amplitude previews and a validated head tab config.
notes: Reuse msg_serializer._serialize_depth_image (:218, red-green today, clip _DEPTH_MIN_MM/_DEPTH_MAX_MM at :22-23); dispatch at :173. A topic missing in TOPIC_TYPE_HINTS is silently not subscribed (bridge.py:90-106, subscription_spec :172), so test subscription. Real data only: no placeholder frames.
verify: cd nodes/web_ui && uv run pytest tests/test_config.py tests/test_bridge.py tests/test_msg_serializer.py -q && uv run poe lint
